_what: How tool:keep-channels-latest-videos-and-captions (do-work/harvest-channels.mjs) asks a video site for listings and captions: politely, one request at a time, inside one run's time. Every number here is a setting, not code. `program` names the program and the folders it is looked for in: `places`, then `places_under_home` (folders under the home folder of the account the run is started by), then the run's PATH; the first folder holding an executable file of that name wins. `always` is given to every request, and `js_runtime_option` names the run's own node to the program (null leaves it out). `seconds_between_requests` is a range: each wait is drawn from it. A request whose error words contain one of `refusal_words` (the site asking whether the caller is a robot, or answering too many requests) ends the run, and the caller waits `pause_after_refusal.first_minutes`, doubled for each refusal in a row up to `doublings_at_most` times, before it sends `again`. `requests_per_run_at_most` bounds one run; `budget_seconds` is how long a run works when the caller says nothing (`default`) and at most (`most`), kept under the engine's run deadline; `seconds_kept_for_records` is held back at the end when rows are written; a request starts only when at least `least_seconds_for_a_request` remain, and is stopped when the budget runs out or after `request_seconds_at_most`. `file_bytes_at_most` is the most one output file holds (the row's outputs max_bytes is the same number). `records` is the record type and id start the row's rights name and the most records one write carries (the row's most_writes). `info_fields` are the fields of the site's own description of a video a caption line keeps, and `comment_fields` the fields of each comment. `window_list_at_most` is how many of a seed's newest videos are listed when days (`between`) or `eras` are asked for, so they can be chosen from; `eras_at_most` is the most spans the days may be split into. `comment_mix` holds the bounds of a comment mix (`videos_at_most`, `read_default` comments read per video, `each_at_most` comments of one kind) and `disagreement_words`: the words (matched whole, any case) that make a comment a disagreement, in the language of the comments read. `posts` is the same politeness for tool:keep-public-posts-by-link (do-work/harvest-posts.mjs): `mirror_base` is the address of the third-party public mirror that answers one post as JSON at <mirror_base>/<user>/status/<id> (change it here if the mirror moves or is replaced), `link_pattern` reads the user and id out of a post link, `answer_field` is the field of the mirror's answer that holds the post, `user_agent` is what the run calls itself, `links_at_most` and `skip_ids_at_most` bound the input, `answer_bytes_at_most` the mirror's answer, and `post_fields` the fields of the post that are kept.
